svg.title: Labrador Current: described latitude-gate separation
svg.desc: Conditional geographic floor from a regional prose description. Not a mapped current route or whole-current length. Nine editorial gate scenarios are not physical uncertainty or seasonal variability.
svg.text: Rounded down to 100 km; no measured centerline or guaranteed physical minimum.
Editorial sensitivity only; no annual range, confidence interval or source position error.
Thompson et al. (2009), §4.2 ¶29, original PDF pages 6–7. Branches differ.
Diagram is scalar. The calculation meridian is not a current location.
